description: This Java source file defines the ComponentConfig class and related inner classes, modeling the configuration of an 'ofbiz-component' element in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading, managing, and retrieving component configuration details, dependencies, resources, classpaths, web applications, and security keystores.

classes.name: ComponentConfig
classes.description: Main class representing the configuration of an OFBiz component, including methods for loading, accessing, and managing component details, dependencies, resources, classpaths, web apps, and keystores.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing immutable ComponentConfig instances with flexible property setting.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ClasspathInfo
classes.description: Models the <classpath> element, representing classpath locations and types (DIR or JAR).

classes.name: ComponentConfig.EntityResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <entity-resource> element, representing entity resource details.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.KeystoreInfo
classes.description: Models the <keystore> element, representing keystore details and providing access to KeyStore objects.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for resource-related elements, providing resource handler creation and location info.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceLoaderInfo
classes.description: Models the <resource-loader> element, representing resource loader configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ServiceResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <service-resource> element, representing service resource details.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.TestSuiteInfo
classes.description: Models the <test-suite> element, representing test suite configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.WebappInfo
classes.description: Models the <webapp> element, representing web application configurations, including server, context, permissions, and virtual hosts.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ClasspathInfo.Type
classes.description: Enum representing classpath location types: DIR or JAR.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ComponentConfigCache
classes.description: Caches and manages ComponentConfig instances, including dependency sorting based on 'depends-on' elements.

methods.name: componentExists
methods.description: Checks if a component with the given name exists in the cache.

methods.name: matchingComponentName
methods.description: Creates a predicate to match components by name, allowing null for any component.

methods.name: getAllClasspathInfos
methods.description: Returns all classpath information from all components.

methods.name: getAllComponents
methods.description: Returns all cached component configurations.

methods.name: sortDependencies
methods.description: Sorts components based on dependencies, throws exception on cycles or invalid dependencies.

methods.name: components
methods.description: Streams all component configurations.

methods.name: getAllConfigurations
methods.description: Returns all container configurations from components.

methods.name: getAllEntityResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns entity resource info matching type and optional component name.

methods.name: getAllKeystoreInfos
methods.description: Returns all keystore info from components.

methods.name: getAllServiceResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns service resource info matching type.

methods.name: getAllTestSuiteInfos
methods.description: Returns test suite info for a component, or any if null.

methods.name: getAllWebappResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns all webapp info from components.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a component configuration by global name and optional root location, creating and caching if not found.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Constructs full resource location path based on component, resource loader, and relative location.

methods.name: getKeystoreInfo
methods.description: Finds the first keystore info matching component and keystore name.

methods.name: getRootLocation
methods.description: Returns the root location path of a component by name.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Opens an InputStream for a resource within a component.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a resource within a component.

methods.name: getWebAppInfo
methods.description: Finds webapp info matching server name and context root.

methods.name: getAppBarDisplay
methods.description: Returns whether the app bar is displayed for the webapp.

methods.name: setAppBarDisplay
methods.description: Sets whether the app bar is displayed for the webapp.
